title: The Veil of the Glass Steppe
author: Ada Joubert
blurb: Sebastian Winterbourne, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
